t: The Information Screen is a small screen that can be put adjacent to a machine in order to show some information. By default this screen will show energy information but some machines (like the PowerCells from RFTools Power) have additional viewing options
信息屏幕是一种小型屏幕，可以放在机器旁边以显示一些信息。默认情况下，这个屏幕会显示能量信息，但有些机器（例如 RFTools Power 中的能量单元）还提供额外的显示选项。
Using a wrench on the Information Screen will toggle display mode (if supported by the attached machine)
对信息屏幕使用扳手会切换显示模式（如果所连接的机器支持的话）。
